{{Toy |image1 = DJBoothFigurine.png |release_date = Not releasingMeant to be Mid July 2025, but the figurine got cancelled. |virtual_item = 1st Target - Skin
2nd Target - Skin & [[DJ Booth Figurine Nametag|Nametag]]
3rd Target - {{Color|Ultimate}} Skin & [[DJ Booth Figurine Nametag|Nametag]] |toy_type = Figurine }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''DJ Booth Figurine''' is a cancelled official Paradoxum Games figurine that was formerly available for pre-orders until the 24th of March 2025. Initially, it was available until 3rd of March 2025, but this timeline was extended due to low sales at 413 sales upon its original target date. Due to this, the sale was extended by three weeks, though the sales goal could not be reached even after the extension, and the figurine was therefore cancelled. The product was published under a kickstarter scheme where production of the figurine would only commence if 1,000 sales were hit within {{Time ago|March 24 2025}}. Upon reaching 1,000 pre-orders, customers will obtain a skin in addition to the figurine. Should the product reach 3,000 pre-orders, a [[DJ Booth Figurine Nametag|Nametag]] will be added. Finally, upon reaching 6,000 pre-orders, the skin will now be an {{Color|Ultimate}} skin. Anybody who buys the toy was meant to be emailed a code, which would allow them to get rewards based on the reached target. However, as the figurine got cancelled, this did not happen and the people who bought the toy will get their money refunded. The figurine was meant to be manufactured by Juniper Creates™. The figurine offered the Default [[DJ Booth]], while it mostly resembled the Level 5 appearance it does not exactly match the appearance of any level. The figurine is 8.3 inches (21.08 cm) tall, 7.5 inches (19.05 cm) wide and 7.9 inches (20.066 cm) deep. In addition, a tree is planted for every order of the '''DJ Booth Figurine'''. ==Official Description== *'''Online''' *:Join the rave and help us reach our first target of 1,000 figurines sold to bring this exclusive DJ Booth collectible to life! Comes with a FREE in-game skin! *'''1st Target: 1,000 Units''' *:Party on! Help us hit our first goal of 1,000 figurines sold to bring the DJ Booth Figurine to life with matching in-game skin! If we don't reach the goal this product will not be made and everyone who ordered will receive a full refund. *'''2nd Target: 3,000 Units''' *:Glow-in-the-dark DJ Booth unlocked! Help us hit our second goal of 3,000 figurines sold to level up the DJ Booth Figurine, with special glow-in-the-dark features! PLUS, your in-game skin will also come with a special name tag at this level! If we don’t reach this goal everyone will still receive the 1st target standard figurine and in-game skin (no name tag or glow-in-the-dark features). *'''3rd Target: 6,000 Units''' *:Ultimate rave remix! Help us hit our third goal of 6,000 figurines sold to receive the glow-in-the-dark DJ Booth Figurine and unlock an ultimate in-game skin and name tag! If we don’t reach this goal everyone will still receive the second target glow-in-the-dark figurine and in-game skin with name tag. ==Prices & Stores== The '''DJ Booth Figurine''' could be pre-ordered on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $59.99. While the base price of the figurine does not have dynamic pricing, shipping costs can vary. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Showcase}} DJBoothFigurineShowcase1.png DJBoothFigurineShowcase2.png DJBoothFigurineShowcase3.png DJBoothFigurineShowcase4.gif DJBoothFigurineShowcase5.png DJBoothFigurineShowcase6.png DJBoothFigurineShowcase7.png DJBoothFigurineShowcase8.png DJBoothFigurineShowcase9.png DJBoothFigurineShowcase10.png DJBoothFigurineShowcase11.png {{GalleryHeader|Banners}} FirstTargetDJBoothFigurineBanner.gif SecondTargetDJBoothFigurineBanner.gif ThirdTargetDJBoothFigurineBanner.gif DJBoothFigurineBanner.gif DJ Booth Figurine Launch Banner }} ==Trivia== *This figurine was among the most controversial merchandise in Tower Defense Simulator history, with significant criticism and backlash from the community regarding its high price. ==Notes== {{ToyNavBox}} [[Category:Mini-figures]]
